title: Async Programming
summary: Concurrency without a thread per task: futures and the async/await syntax, runtimes and executors, running futures concurrently with join and race, async channels and streams, and the machinery underneath: Future, Poll, Context, Waker and Pin. Every runnable example uses only the standard library, including an executor you build yourself.
goals: Explain what a future is, why futures are lazy, and what async fn and .await do
Run futures with an executor, and build a minimal block_on from Waker and thread parking
Run several futures concurrently with join and race, and compare tasks with threads
Implement Future by hand with Poll and Waker, and explain Pin, Unpin and streams
